description: nf-core/sarek samplesheet context for germline + somatic variant calling.

pipeline.name: nf-core/sarek
pipeline.core_rule: Required columns: patient, sample, lane, fastq_1, fastq_2, sex, status. status=0 normal, status=1 tumor; tumor/normal pairs share a patient id.

validation_rules: sex must be one of: XX, XY, OTHER (or 'NA' if unknown — sarek tolerates it).
patient groups tumor/normal pairs; the same patient appears in multiple rows.
lane is a per-FASTQ identifier (e.g., L001).
fastq_1/fastq_2 may be HTTPS URLs (ENA mirror) or local paths.

population_priority: Map NExtSEEK donor → patient; sample → sample; tissue type informs status (normal vs tumor).
Use accession_rows for fastq columns. lane defaults to L001 when not present.
